```{r load-pkg}
library(testthat)
library(testhta)

data(base_params)
```

# Introduction

In Health Technology Assessment (HTA), errors in model coding can lead to incorrect reimbursement decisions. While we often validate models against external clinical data, it is equally important to perform **verification**—ensuring the mathematical and logical implementation of the code is internally consistent.

This guide demonstrates how to use `testthat` and `testhta` to perform automated verification tests (`T01`–`T12`) on the 3-state (`Asymptomatic`, `Progressive`, `Dead`) cohort Markov model.

# Setup: The Model Wrapper

Using `run_model()`, we can pass the baseline parameter list `base_params` and override specific parameters for each boundary check:

```{r wrapper}
str(base_params)
```

# Writing Verification Tests

## 1. Discounting Tests (`T06`, `T07`, `T11`)

```{r test-discounting}
test_that("T06: Discounted QALYs are lower than undiscounted QALYs", {
  results_discounted <- run_model(base_params, discount_rate = 0.035)
  results_undiscounted <- run_model(base_params, discount_rate = 0.00)

  qaly_discounted <- get_qalys(results_discounted)
  qaly_undiscounted <- get_qalys(results_undiscounted)

  expect_lt(qaly_discounted["without_drug"], qaly_undiscounted["without_drug"])
  expect_lt(qaly_discounted["with_drug"], qaly_undiscounted["with_drug"])
})

test_that("T07 & T11: High discounting reduces future value to 0", {
  res_high_disc <- run_model(base_params, discount_rate = 1000)
  res_cycle_zero <- run_model(base_params, n_cycles = 1)

  expect_equal(get_costs(res_high_disc), get_costs(res_cycle_zero), tolerance = 0.01)
  expect_equal(get_qalys(res_high_disc), get_qalys(res_cycle_zero), tolerance = 0.01)
})
```

## 2. Unit Costs and Utilities Tests (`T08`)

```{r test-costs}
test_that("T08: Zero intervention cost strictly reduces ICER", {
  c_mat_zero_int <- base_params$state_c_matrix
  c_mat_zero_int["with_drug", "Asymptomatic"] <-
    c_mat_zero_int["without_drug", "Asymptomatic"]

  compare_model_runs(
    extractor_fn = get_icer,
    comparison_fn = expect_lt,
    params_1 = list(state_c_matrix = c_mat_zero_int),
    params_2 = list(),
    data = base_params,
    label = "T08: Intervention costs = 0 reduces ICER"
  )
})
```

## 3. Population Tests (`T03`)

```{r test-population}
test_that("T03: Immediate mortality gives life expectancy of 1", {
  dead_p_matrix <- base_params$p_matrix
  dead_p_matrix[] <- 0
  dead_p_matrix[, "Dead", ] <- 1

  res_death <- run_model(base_params, p_matrix = dead_p_matrix)
  res_le <- get_le_pp(res_death)

  expect_equal(unname(res_le), rep(1, length(res_le)))
})
```
